ordering_rules: Apply site, actor, group, category, deletion, and page-view authority before sorting, counts, limits, or pagination.
Use database writes only to arrange test fixtures. Prove acceptance through public preview, saved-page, action, or browser output.
Keep unsupported module heads, argument shapes, Ajax modules, and mutation events fail closed.
Do not treat page-discussion thread provisioning as authority to create a forum post or a standalone forum thread.
method.source_change_disposition: Current production source already covers every forum-mini behavior established by the sealed 24-case PagePreview matrix. This lane adds the missing public case bindings and no production behavior. The remaining issue 1034 source gaps lack a complete observed contract or a safe mutation boundary, so this lane leaves them explicit instead of inventing forms, routes, or actions.

evidence.authority: Anonymous live PagePreview and saved public workbench observations for MiniRecentThreads, MiniActiveThreads, and MiniRecentPosts.
Twenty-four anonymous live PagePreview inputs and raw outputs with fixed source and output hashes.
Frozen anonymous own-line module outputs for Comments, FrontForum, ForumCategory, ForumNewThread, ForumStart, ForumThread, RecentPosts, and the site-specific RecentThreads observation.

mutation_boundary_audit.page_discussion_create_is_not_post_autho: wikidot_page_discussion_create checks page visibility and discussion settings, then provisions one empty page-discussion thread with locking and idempotency. It does not create, edit, or delete a forum post, and it does not create a standalone ForumNewThread thread.
mutation_boundary_audit.request_csrf_boundary: Framerail enables SvelteKit origin checking outside the local environment. The Ajax handler accepts wikidot_token7 as a control field but does not validate it for forum actions.
mutation_boundary_audit.decision: Do not connect Comments, ForumNewThread, ForumThread, or RecentPosts mutation controls. No public endpoint currently combines a request actor, forum permission, mutation domain rule, and action-specific CSRF or rate-limit policy.

source_ready.result: The public preview test now names every sealed input. It covers the default limit, positive limit, zero, negative, text, unknown argument, inline owner, and raw owner for all three modules.

The public saved-page test covers recent and active thread order, routes, dates, reply counts, recent reply order, page and forum anchors, plain excerpts, printuser output, and standalone root exclusion.

ledger_reconciliation.rule: Do not mark a forum feature implemented or close its issue until every source-ready row has an exact candidate receipt, every needs-source row is implemented through a public seam, and every blocked-evidence row is resolved by authoritative evidence and matching local authority.

closure_rule: This lane does not close either issue. Source-ready rows need central Rust or Node validation and exact-candidate receipts. Needs-source rows remain open.
